subject: Organometallic RESP charge derivation for use with AmberTools

messages.author: Sam Walsworth (Researcher)
messages.body:
Hi All
I am curious what is the best way to generate organosilver RESP charges for use with AmberTools (before MD simulation with GROMACS)? I was considering doing this with NWChem (which I've used to create bond/angle parameters for my organosilver complexes) but I am aware of R.E.D. Server Development which may be a better option.
Anyone got any experience with this?
Sam

messages.author: Vaibhav Dixit
messages.body:
Many people are using mcpb.py i.e. metal center bond parameter python tool
for parameterization of zn, cu and fe complexes. There's a tutorial on
Amber website that you can check.
